plugins.name: Hello OpenCreator
plugins.author: OpenCreator
plugins.description: Example plugin: a Klippy module, a macro and a Moonraker endpoint. The place to start when making a plugin.

plugins.name: Printer Buddy Lite
plugins.author: Printer Buddy
plugins.description: Print failure detection on the printer's own X2600 RISC-V core, with a web page on port 7180.
plugins.note: Install it on the printer, also on tunneled printers, where it finds the SBC's Moonraker by itself.

plugins.name: Shake&Tune (numpy only)
plugins.author: OpenCreator
plugins.description: Experimental. Klippain Shake&Tune (input shaper, belts, vibrations and axes map graphs) on the printer itself, using a numpy-only stand-in for matplotlib.
plugins.note: Experimental, and needs a lot of system resources: drawing each graph keeps the CPU busy for about a minute and uses up to about 130 MB of memory. Needs git (opkg install git). Graphs are saved in ShakeTune_results next to printer.cfg.

plugins.name: OctoEverywhere for OpenCreator
plugins.author: KidCe
plugins.note: After installing, run sh /usr/data/opencreator/plugins/octoeverywhere/install.sh and follow its README.

plugins.name: Orca Filament Profiles
plugins.author: Xmister
plugins.description: Pick which OrcaSlicer filament preset each AFC material uses when Orca syncs filaments. Needs OrcaSlicer 2.5 or later.
plugins.note: AFC now supports this itself, so this plugin may be of little use. If you still want it: put your material-to-preset mappings in orca-filament-profiles/mapping.cfg next to printer.cfg (see its README) and restart Klipper.

plugins.name: Script Runner
plugins.author: pappicio
plugins.description: Automatically runs user shell and Python scripts at startup in both SoC and Tunneled modes.
plugins.note: Required by Touchscreen Server. Install this plugin first.

plugins.name: Touchscreen Server
plugins.author: pappicio
plugins.description: Remote touchscreen access for GrumpyScreen and HelixScreen through a web browser.
plugins.note: Requires Script Runner. Install Script Runner first. After installation, open the URL displayed in the installation output to access the printer touchscreen remotely. May degrade performance. Support will not be given unless running under tunneled.

plugins.name: OpenCreator Display Manager
plugins.author: pappicio
plugins.description: Switch between HelixScreen and GrumpyScreen using Klipper macros.
plugins.note: Requires Script Runner. Install Script Runner first. May impact printer performance. No support will be provided when running in SoC mode, including performance issues or MCU shutdowns.

plugins.name: Samba Share
plugins.author: pappicio
plugins.description: Provides network access to /usr/data through an SMB share.
plugins.note: Requires Entware. Exposes /usr/data as a writable network share. Guest access is enabled, so use only on a trusted local network.

plugins.name: OpenCreator Spoolman Integration
plugins.description: A Spoolman spool per tool through AFC, each tool books filament on its own spool.
plugins.note: After installing, put your Spoolman server's address in oc-spoolman.conf (next to moonraker.conf) and uncomment its [spoolman] section, then restart Moonraker and run FIRMWARE_RESTART. Optionally, group the SPOOLMAN_* macros in a Fluidd category by hand (README, Setup step 5).
plugins.author: JayKuswahey

plugins.name: API Server
plugins.author: pappicio
plugins.description: Provides HTTP API endpoints for Creator 5 mode switching and synchronization with a remote Linux host.
plugins.note: Requires Script Runner on Creator 5 and Mode Monitor installed on the Raspberry Pi, Radxa ZERO 3W, or another compatible remote Linux host. Mode Monitor: https://github.com/pappicio/Raspberry-C5-klipper_mode_monitor. Both components are required for complete mode switching and data synchronization.

plugins.name: OpenCreator Commander
plugins.author: pappicio
plugins.description: Advanced filesystem manager for FlashForge Creator 5, featuring file browsing, editing, an integrated SSH terminal, customizable interface settings, and read-only protection for critical system files.
plugins.note: Support is provided only when the printer is running in Tunneled Mode. The author accepts no responsibility for damage, data loss, or malfunctions resulting from improper use of this plugin. Use it at your own risk.
